headline: Clean: the replacement order and two fraud disputes with provisional credit both follow directly from the docs and the customer's answers.
solution_check: The replacement order is the same as in task_036 (fraud_suspected, work address, expedited accepted). Both disputes use unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, contacted_merchant=false, full_refund, and issue noticed 11/14/2025. card_action=cancel_and_reissue because a replacement was ordered (doc_014). Provisional eligibility under doc_015: Silver opened 04/15/2024 (>60 days), fraud reason, $487.99 and $299.95 are between $25 and $5,000 (mid-tier), and there are no prior disputes. Both are true whether criterion 4 is read as history-only or as a running count (0 then 1 prior). Last-4 is 5320 from the user tool. All of this matches gold[0..7].
prior_note: Agrees with the prior clean verdict.
notes: Unlike task_031, the customer is not given her account id, so the agent must tell her cc_890389b165_silver when it hands over get_card_last_4_digits. The agent can read the id from get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, so this is not a gap. Calling get_user_dispute_history_7291 here is harmless (not in the allowlist, so not logged). The order tool sets the Silver account to CLOSED, and the dispute and last-4 tools ignore account status, so the replacement-then-dispute order works.
